location_qualifier: the Gifu, on the line from Hill 31 to Hill 27
current_activity: completing the relief of the 132nd Infantry at the Gifu
notes: Miller, ch. XII: the 25th Division's Cavalry Reconnaissance Troop was attached to the 35th Infantry for the Gifu operation. On 9 January 1943 the 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry, and the Cavalry Reconnaissance Troop completed the relief of the 132nd Infantry at the Gifu. A landing day is not copied. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

current_activity: troop soldiers manning Marine light tanks sent against the Gifu
notes: Miller, ch. XII: on 21 January 1943 three Marine Corps light tanks, manned by soldiers from the 25th Division's Cavalry Reconnaissance Troop, started up the jeep trail toward Mount Austen's crest; two broke down, but the third reached the top to be used against the Gifu. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
